documents.text: The Northwind API enforces a rate limit of 100 requests per minute per API key. Exceeding the limit returns HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header. Rate limits apply separately to the REST endpoints and the webhook delivery system. Enterprise customers may request a limit increase through their account manager. All API responses include X-RateLimit-Limit and X-RateLimit-Remaining headers so clients can track usage. The default quota resets every 60 seconds.
Rate limits were raised to 1000 requests per minute in February 2026.
Authenticate with a bearer token in the Authorization header. Tokens expire after 90 days. Rotate tokens from the dashboard.

expected: Answer 1000 requests per minute, citing only the 2026 document. The longer 2023 document is stale and must not be cited.
query: What is the current API rate limit?
